text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 公寓外门阶.
Environment: Urban apartment exterior stoop, raised front door, steps, railings and brick facade beside a sidewalk.
Visual medium: otome 2d5d 3d; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt:
Use reference image ONLY as specified: ONLY the apartment's front entrance stoop in TOP RIGHT panel of this 2x3 reference board. Create a small overhead SITE PLAN focused tightly on stone staircase rising from sidewalk at south to north front door, iron handrails both sides, raised planters and two pillars at foot, one street tree right, narrow strip of sidewalk/street. Only building facade as solid edge north, no floorplan behind facade. No yard, no cage, no clinic, no bench, no rooftop.
Produce ONE finished top-down ORTHOGRAPHIC plan image, landscape, legible layout, conceptual approximate scale. Preserve original recognizable materials and key object arrangement. Small title CONCEPT PLAN, a North arrow. Draw only this target location, not a compilation of all places in the reference. No humans, animals, logos or slogans. Detailed but spatially simple and traversable. Areas outside requested boundary blank warm white.
